<includeonly>{{DeAgostini|url=shop/subscriptions/details/star_wars_starships_vehicles_collection|old=1|lang=co.uk|text=Star Wars Starships & Vehicles Collection}} indicates that a new issue of ''[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection]]'' was published every two weeks, and the various snapshots establish that [[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 13|issue 13]] was published prior to [[March 25]], [[2009]], [[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 50|issue 50]] by [[August 17]], [[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 57|issue 57]] by [[November 22]], and [[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 59|issue 59]] by [[December 29]]. From these datapoints, it can be calculated that the series began publication at the end of [[September]] [[2008]]. Therefore, it can be determined that [[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection {{{1|}}}|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' {{{1|}}}]] was published in approximately {{#switch:{{{1}}}
